a2a.disabled: Agent-to-agent deals are not switched on yet. You can prepare your mandates now, but your agent will not act until it is enabled.
a2a.controlNotice: You stay in control. Your agent only works inside the limits you set, it can never go below your private floor price, and no deal exists until you confirm it. You can pause or revoke a mandate at any time.

overview.title: Your quoting agent
overview.description: Give your agent a mandate and it negotiates with buyers' agents for you, inside your limits. Every step is logged below.
overview.mandatesEmptyDescription: Create a mandate below to let your agent quote from your price book.
overview.needPriceBook: Your agent quotes from your price book. Add or activate a price book entry first.

form.name: Mandate name
form.priceBookHint: Your agent quotes from this entry.
form.floor: Lowest price you will accept (Rs per unit)
form.floorHint: Private. Never shown to buyers or their agents.
form.maxDiscount: Largest discount from your list price (%)
form.capacityHint: Optional. Your agent will not commit to more than this.
form.expiresHint: Optional. The mandate stops on this date.
form.optIn: I want an agent to negotiate for me inside these limits. Nothing is committed until I confirm each deal.
form.autoStartsOff: Auto-accept starts switched off. You can turn it on later, separately.

mandate.title: Mandate
mandate.description: Limits, auto-accept, status and every change made to this mandate.
mandate.floorPrivate: Your floor price is private and is never shared with the other side.
mandate.editNote: Changes apply to new negotiations. Negotiations already running keep the limits they started with.
mandate.closedNote: This mandate has ended and can no longer be changed.

auto.heading: Auto-accept
auto.onNote: Your agent may accept a deal on its own at Rs {price} or more.
auto.offNote: Every deal waits for your confirmation.
auto.limitLabel: Lowest price your agent may accept on its own (Rs per unit)
auto.limitHint: Must not be below your floor price.
auto.consent: I understand that my agent can accept deals on its own at or above this price, without asking me first.

controls.heading: Pause or revoke
controls.revokeWarning: Revoking ends the mandate and withdraws every negotiation that is still running. It cannot be undone; create a new mandate to start again.

negotiation.title: Negotiation
negotiation.description: The full offer history between your agent and the buyer's agent.

conf.auto: Accepted by your agent within your limits

negotiation.external: The buyer used an outside agent connected through the API.

decision.heading: Your decision
decision.notCommitted: Nothing is committed until you confirm.
decision.waitingOther: Waiting for the other side to confirm.
decision.realiseFailed: The deal was agreed but could not be recorded yet.

transcript.heading: Transcript
transcript.caption: Every offer and reply in this negotiation

errors.enterRupees: Enter {label} as an amount in rupees, for example 1250 or 1250.50.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box to confirm you understand.
errors.optInRequired: Confirm that you want an agent to act for you.
